plan.title: Lab 2 Windows start has no ready signal and CRLF commit warnings look like failure

narratives.Description: Lab 2 Windows start has no ready signal and CRLF commit warnings look like failure
narratives.Overview:
## What happened

Lab 2 on Windows PowerShell 7.6.6 completed (init, doctor exit 0, toolchain exit 0, accept PASS, archive). Two instruction problems remain.

1. The Unix start function prints module_02_start=ready. The Windows start block never prints that token. The Unix section says Continue only after module_02_start=ready. A Windows learner searching the page for that signal will not find it in their session.

2. After directive init, git commit of the checkpoint emits a large block of "LF will be replaced by CRLF" warnings for deposited skill/command files. The recovery table does not mention this. It is easy to read as a failed checkpoint. The commit still succeeded (checkpoint: initialize fictional Directive consumer on training/module-02).

Doctor also printed the documented false negative Missing directory: xbrief/ while xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json existed, plus canonical-vendored-npm-signpost. Those are already taught; the CRLF noise is not.

## Suggested repair

Print an explicit Windows ready signal, or stop telling Windows learners to wait for the Unix token. Add a recovery row: CRLF replacement warnings on core.autocrlf=true hosts are expected and do not fail the checkpoint.
